name: Comic Con India (Mumbai)
blurb: Mumbai leg of Comic Con India's national pop-culture tour, run with ReedPop, with comics-industry and pop-culture guests.

last.venue: Jio World Convention Centre, Bandra Kurla Complex

notes: Re-checked comicconindia.com fresh (--fresh) (only an 'all-cities-main-page/mumbai-comic-con' pattern from last season, which still 404s); the site's only current, confirmed city pages are Visakhapatnam, Navi Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad and Jalandhar (Oct-Dec 2026), confirming no 2026-27 Mumbai edition has been announced yet. Added 'last': multiple outlets (curlytales.com, theory9.in, technosports.co.in recap 'Mumbai Never Disappoints: Comic Con 2026 Closes the Season with 55,000 Fans') confirm the most recent Mumbai edition ran May 9-10, 2026 at Jio World Convention Centre, BKC - already over before the research window (2026-10-05) opened.
